name: tv.tootie/gotify-rmcp
title: Gotify MCP
description: MCP server for Gotify push notifications — send alerts, manage apps and clients, browse message history.

environmentVariables.name: GOTIFY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Gotify server, e.g. https://gotify.example.com.

environmentVariables.name: GOTIFY_CLIENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Gotify client token (starts with C) for management operations — list/create/delete apps, clients, and messages.

environmentVariables.name: GOTIFY_APP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Gotify application token (starts with A) used exclusively for sending messages via POST /message.

environmentVariables.name: GOTIFY_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for MCP HTTP endpoint authentication. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32.
